editorial.blurb: Authentic Xi'an cuisine in a warm, unpretentious setting where lamb skewers, hand-pulled noodles, and cumin-spiced flatbreads deliver serious flavor at gentle prices.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the lamb skewers and Biang Biang noodles—regulars rave about their chewy texture and rich flavor. Bring chili oil or ask for it if you want to amp up heat, and note the single server is genuinely nice but Chinese language helps.
